_readme: Every health number or claim Pal uses must point to an id here. status: verified = a person has read the source and confirmed it supports the claim; to-verify = not yet checked, must not be shown to testers. A registered dietitian reviews this file before Gate G.

sources.title: International Society of Sports Nutrition Position Stand: protein and exercise (Jäger et al., 2017)
supports: 1.4 to 2.0 g protein per kg per day for most exercising adults
about 0.25 g/kg (20 to 40 g) protein per meal
2.3 to 3.1 g/kg for resistance-trained people dieting for fat loss (not applied by default)

sources.title: Harvard Health: calorie deficit approach used by its weight center
supports: aim for 1 to 2 lb loss per week at most
do not go below about 1,200 kcal (women) or 1,500 kcal (men)
warning signs: persistent fatigue, irritability, preoccupation with food
